rationale: P6-B was a condensed perceptual probe. This file maps its accepted dramatic/performance functions onto exact frozen S15 Program segments without fuzzy text matching and without changing the frozen narrative.

frozen_authority.locator_basis: one-based Program segment index + exact speaker/text guard
frozen_authority.rebind_reason: Program metadata/cache-identity maintenance changed the Program blob while frozen spoken text and all 37 product-owned guards remained exact.

staging_contract.pauses: preserve H1b-B earned-pause intent; measured timing remains authoritative
staging_contract.rule: The bed test grows more intimate by subtraction, not by increased sound density.

penelope_local_performance.scope_rule: Apply the accepted P6-B expressive family only to the bed-test trap/verdict segments below. Pénélope outside this list keeps the established production baseline unless H2 reveals a concrete regression.

segments.speaker: PÉNÉLOPE
segments.text: Et fais sortir le lit. Mettez-le dans le couloir. Nous aurons plus de place.

segments.speaker: PÉNÉLOPE
segments.text: Parce que je devais savoir si toi, tu pouvais l’être.

segments.speaker: PÉNÉLOPE
segments.text: Les hommes reviennent de la guerre et disent qu’ils sont les mêmes.

segments.speaker: PÉNÉLOPE
segments.text: Les voyageurs reviennent et racontent qu’ils ont seulement vu davantage de choses.

segments.speaker: PÉNÉLOPE
segments.text: Toi, tu as disparu vingt ans.

segments.speaker: PÉNÉLOPE
segments.text: J’avais besoin d’une chose qui ne puisse pas voyager avec ton histoire.

ulysses_emotional_performance.scope_rule: Apply the human-qualified emotional capability only to these exact reaction segments. Do not recast Ulysse globally and do not apply expressive styling to the explanatory olive-tree passage by default.

groups.intent: immediate personal shock; low theatricality; no shout

segments.speaker: ULYSSE
segments.text: On ne peut pas déplacer ce lit.

groups.intent: contained hurt; the voice may catch, but never melodrama

segments.speaker: ULYSSE
segments.text: Et si l’arbre a été coupé—

segments.speaker: ULYSSE
segments.text: Alors tu aurais dû le savoir.

groups.intent: shock turning into recognition and intimate release; reduce projection

explanatory_baseline_segments.text: Il n’a pas été posé dans cette chambre.
J’ai construit la chambre autour de lui.
Il y avait un olivier à cet endroit.
Je n’ai pas voulu le couper.
J’ai taillé le tronc à la hauteur qu’il fallait.
J’en ai fait un des pieds du lit.
Si quelqu’un a déplacé ce lit, alors il a fallu couper l’arbre.

latest_external_candidate.authority_rule: Do not consume or materialize this candidate unless Stream 2 publishes ULYSSES_EMOTIONAL_HUMAN_PASS.

ulysses_emotional_performance.production_capture_rule: Record and human-select exactly one clean take for each of the 12 exact mapped S15 segments before any BeltOut conversion. Raw human audio remains private.
ulysses_emotional_performance.post_capture_rule: Exactly one BeltOut conversion per frozen selected take; no best-of-N, no second pass, constant level alignment only.

fail_closed_guards: Each mapped segment must still match the exact speaker and text above.
If S15 Program segment numbering or text drifts, this binding is invalid until Stream 1 deliberately rebinds it.
No silent fallback from the Pénélope local recipe or Ulysse emotional package.
No narrative rewrite is authorized by this binding.
